explanation.new: Unused and unopened, in the packaging the manufacturer shipped it in.
explanation.open_box: Never used, but the packaging has been opened — a return or a display unit.
explanation.refurbished_manufacturer: Restored and re-certified by the manufacturer or its authorised programme.
explanation.refurbished_seller: Restored by the seller or a third party, who is named on this listing.
explanation.used_like_new: Used, with no wear the seller can see at normal viewing distance.
explanation.used_good: Used, with light wear the seller says does not affect how it works.
explanation.used_fair: Used, with obvious wear or a fault the seller has described.
explanation.used_poor: Used, heavily worn or with a described fault that affects using it.
explanation.for_parts: Sold as not working — for repair, salvage or components.

condition.disclaimer: A condition is what the seller states about their own item. It is not a Mercaria guarantee.

explanation.highest_policy_score: Scores best across everything we know about these offers — price, delivery, condition, seller rating and how recently we checked.
explanation.lowest_item_price: The lowest item price of the offers we can compare in this currency.
explanation.lowest_known_total: The lowest total including delivery, among the offers whose delivery cost we know.
explanation.verified_official_channel: A channel the brand has verified as its own.
explanation.verified_authorized_reseller: A reseller the brand has verified as authorised.
explanation.shortest_known_delivery: The shortest delivery estimate any of these sellers published.
explanation.nearest_collection_point: The nearest collection point we know of.
explanation.lowest_item_price_new_segment: The lowest item price among the offers sold as new.
explanation.lowest_item_price_used_segment: The lowest item price among the second-hand offers.
explanation.buyable_on_mercaria: You can buy this here, without leaving Mercaria.

resultDefinition.cheapestKnownItemPrices: Compares item prices only. Delivery and tax are not included in this figure.
resultDefinition.cheapestKnownTotal: Compares the full delivered total. Produced only when every item price, every merchant's delivery and the tax treatment are known.
resultDefinition.fewestMerchants: The plan that spreads your basket across the fewest separate checkouts.
resultDefinition.bestNativePlan: The items you can buy directly on Mercaria, in one cart.
resultDefinition.officialChannelPlan: Every item from a brand's verified official channel.
resultDefinition.bestNearbyPickup: Not planned here — a basket comparison has no location to measure from. Check collection on a product's own page.
resultDefinition.partialCoverage: Some items could not be planned. The rest are shown with the reasons.

comparison.explanationFallbackNotice: This summary is generated from the comparison table below, without a language model.

confidence.sufficient: Based on enough comparable offers to say
confidence.strong: Based on a wide sample of comparable offers

meaning.lowestObservedItemPrice: The lowest item price we recorded in this condition, in this market and over this window. Prices we judged to be data errors are set aside and listed separately.
meaning.lowestObservedKnownTotal: The lowest total including delivery, among the offers whose delivery cost the seller actually published. Offers that published none are excluded rather than treated as free.
meaning.currentVsRecentMedian: Today's price against the middle of what we recorded over this window — how it compares with itself lately, not with other sellers today.
meaning.materialPriceDrop: How far the current price has fallen against the most recent earlier price we recorded and judged sound.
meaning.typicalRecentRange: The middle half of the prices we recorded over this window. Both ends are prices somebody actually charged.
meaning.officialStorePosition: The price at a store the brand has verified as its own, against the other new offers we can compare. It excludes the official store's own price from that comparison.
meaning.priceQualityLabel: Today's price against the middle of the offers we can compare right now, one price per seller.

unmeasured.noActivePolicy: We have not published a definition for this comparison yet.
unmeasured.insufficientObservations: We have not recorded enough prices to say.
unmeasured.insufficientDistinctSellers: Too few different sellers to call this a market.
unmeasured.insufficientDistinctOffers: Too few separate offers to compare.
unmeasured.insufficientTimeCoverage: We have not been watching this for long enough.
unmeasured.noEligibleCurrentOffer: There is no offer we can compare right now.
unmeasured.noComparableHistory: We have no comparable price history for this.
unmeasured.currencyNotConvertible: We cannot express these prices in the currency you asked for.
unmeasured.segmentNotApplicable: This comparison is only defined for new items.
unmeasured.measureNotApplicable: This measure does not apply here.
unmeasured.demandMeasurementUnavailable: We do not measure demand for a product yet.

competitiveness.demandWithoutNativeOffer: Demand without an offer from you

eligibilityLoss.availabilityUnknown: The source does not say whether this is in stock.

eligibilityLoss.destinationMissing: There is no link a buyer can follow to this offer.
eligibilityLoss.conditionUnknown: The condition of this item is not stated in a form we can map.
eligibilityLoss.priceMissing: No price is published for this offer.

recommendation.aboveEligibleMedian: Your current price is above the median of the offers we can compare.

recommendation.refreshWouldRestoreEligibility: Refreshing this offer would bring it back into the comparison.
recommendation.wouldBeCheapestItemPrice: At this observed price, this offer would be the cheapest item price once it is being compared again.

pinEffect.channelWins: This channel's “Keep my local edits” setting is off, so the next sync overwrites them with the platform's values.
pinEffect.unknown: Whether a later sync overwrites them is the channel's “Keep my local edits” setting.

explanation.sold_by_mercaria: Mercaria is the seller for this item. Your contract, your payment and your returns are with Mercaria.
explanation.fulfilled_by_approved_partner: An approved fulfilment partner ships this item from their own stock. Mercaria remains the seller.
explanation.sold_by_merchant: This item is sold by the merchant named above. Mercaria processes the payment.
explanation.external_checkout: You will finish this purchase on the retailer's own site. Mercaria does not take the payment, hold the order or handle the return.
explanation.affiliate_disclosure: Mercaria may be paid a commission if you buy through this link. It does not change the price you pay, and it does not affect how offers are ordered.
explanation.referral_disclosure: You arrived through a partner link. It does not change the price, the seller or your rights.
explanation.supply_confirmation_pending: Payment received. We are confirming availability with our fulfilment partner before this order is confirmed.
explanation.price_or_availability_changed: The price or availability of something in your basket has changed since you added it. Check it before paying.
explanation.procurement_failed_refund_pending: We could not source this item. Your refund has already been started; it will reach the card you paid with.
explanation.returns_and_warranty: Return it within the window shown, and the legal guarantee applies for the period shown.
explanation.tax_or_import_uncertainty: Import duties or taxes may be charged on delivery for this destination. We cannot state a final amount.
explanation.product_recall_or_safety_notice: There is a safety notice affecting this product. Do not use it before reading the notice.

commercial.rights: Cancel within %{cancellationHours} hours of ordering, withdraw within %{withdrawalDays} days of delivery, return within %{returnDays} days, and the legal guarantee runs for %{warrantyMonths} months.

explanation.partially_refunded: Part of this order has been refunded.

blockReason.destination_unknown: Tell us where this is going and we can price it.
blockReason.shipping_not_quotable: We cannot get a delivery price for this destination right now.
blockReason.undocumented_supplier_fee: There is a cost we cannot account for, so we will not quote a total.
blockReason.tax_undetermined: We cannot determine the tax for this destination.
blockReason.market_not_supported: We cannot sell this item into that market.

unquoted.no_current_quote: We do not have a current price for this item.
unquoted.destination_not_supplied: Tell us where this is going and we can price it.
unquoted.retail_not_enabled: This item is not currently on sale.

explanation.held: Earned and waiting out its hold period. Nothing is lost while it waits, and the amount can still fall if the purchase behind it is refunded.
explanation.vested: The hold has passed and no reversal reached it. It joins the next payout run once your account clears the payout checks and the balance reaches the minimum.
explanation.frozen: Paused while something is reviewed — a dispute on the purchase, or a check on the account. The hold clock stops rather than restarting, and it returns to where it was if the review clears.
explanation.paid: Sent to your payout destination. A payment is never un-made after the fact.
explanation.voided: The money it was drawn from went away — usually a refund — so the reward went with it. The record stays, with the reason.
